This product is supplied without battery and charger. DeWalt 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 6328D.

Compact random orbital sander with a precision-engineered brushless motor for the toughest of applications. Features variable speed control, texturised rubber overmoulded grip, dust bag and a replaceable 8-hole hook-and-loop sanding pad for quick, easy paper changing. Ideal for a wide variety of sanding applications, such as sanding wood, metal, plastics and painted surfaces. Features wireless tool control capability which provides automatic connection between tool and applicable extractor. Compatible with DEWALT 18V Li-Ion XR battery system (batteries and chargers sold separately). Requires 125mm sanding discs with an 8-hole dust extraction pattern.
